subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-08-28
html:
Week 13 Pulse

First pulse past the original 12-week-strategy.md window (kickoff 2026-07-04, that plan's own Week 12 closed last pulse). Shipped since last pulse (2026-08-21): a fix for broken OG/Twitter meta + wrong-page WebPage schema + missing FAQPage schema across all 15 /destinations/[slug] pages (2026-08-24), and "alternative to X" comparison sections (feature table + when-to-choose lists) on the 3 highest-searched destination pages — Looker Studio, Power BI, BigQuery — plus a missing dateModified field added to all 15 (2026-08-27, closing sxo.md quick-win #6). Connector matrix and comparison hub both remain fully caught up with no further items until a human unblocks catalog.ts. The headline is unchanged: rank positions are still flat at zero after a fourth full week of daily checks — see below.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 API access. Waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

Fourth full week of daily position checks for the askarlo.app SE Ranking project (site_id 12704162, Google US), 2026-08-21 through 2026-08-28. Result: still 0 of 22 tracked keywords have a measurable position (all outside the top 100) on every single day checked, no exceptions, for the fourth consecutive week.

Checked every daily position (08-21 through 08-28, 8 consecutive days, all 22 keywords) directly via getKeywordStats — pos: 0 (unranked) on literally every keyword/day combination, no partial or flickering rankings anywhere in the window, same as the three prior pulses. SE Ranking's own project summary confirms it: top5/top10/top30/visibility all read 0 as of today. Month 2 (August) has now closed with neither KPI met — KPI #1 ("first measured position for ≥15 of 22 keywords") and KPI #2 (3 lowest-KD terms entering top-50) both went the full four-week window at zero. The plan now enters its Month 3 window (12-week-strategy.md Weeks 9–12) without either Month 2 leading indicator in hand.

Traffic vs last week

Pending / unchanged. SE Ranking's own organic + paid index (getDomainOverviewByCountry, US) still shows zero indexed keywords for askarlo.app — consistent with 0/22 tracked positions above. Backlinks (getBacklinksSummary, domain mode): still 2 backlinks / 1 referring domain, still only from futurlabs.dev — unchanged across all four weekly pulses since backlink tracking began (2026-08-01). AI search overview (getAiSearchOverview, US, all engines): still 0 link_presence, 0 ai_opportunity_traffic, null average_position, null brand_presence, and still no prior-period baseline for a delta — unchanged from every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No build/pipeline regressions. Clean rm -rf .next && npm install && npm run build this session — compiled successfully, same 9 pre-existing (app)/* + /welcome prerender failures as every prior session (missing NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL, Vercel-only secret), not a regression; npm run lint clean (only the same pre-existing unrelated sitemap/page.tsx CSS-tag warning). SEO Report Email Action: 26 of 27 runs green all-time (same single historical failure as every prior pulse — the first shakeout run on 2026-07-04); both sessions since the last pulse (2026-08-24, 2026-08-27) sent and archived cleanly. Keepalive: 3/3 green.

mailchimp's catalog.ts ETA ("August 2026") closes out this week still coming_soon, unmet. Re-checked src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts this session, unchanged again: meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages ("May 2026") are 3+ months overdue; hubspot/mailerlite ("July 2026") are 6+ weeks overdue; tiktok_ads/stripe ("June 2026") are 2+ months overdue; shopify ("April 2026") remains the single most-overdue entry at 4+ months past its own date. salesforce/pipedrive still waitlist; gohighlevel/clarity/gtm still absent entirely. Every coming_soon entry in the catalog is now past its own stated ETA, with none flipped to live since the connector matrix was completed 2026-08-03. Open since 2026-07-20, now 13+ sessions, still needs a human product-owner call before any of these get a public marketing page.

Off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 — the single most overdue item on the whole plan, flagged since Week 4, still blocked on a human with a browser (this sandbox has no outbound HTTP). GSC submission is also still open, unchanged since kickoff (2026-07-04). The dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold (open since 2026-07-30) and the ChatGPT-assistant-column connector variant (flagged 2026-08-06, needs a human to confirm ChatGPT connector support is actually live before pages get built for it) both remain open human-decision items.

Reading the week

Content and technical-correctness work stayed disciplined this week — both sessions closed genuinely open gaps (a real schema/meta bug across all 15 destination pages, then a named SXO quick-win) rather than adding volume for its own sake. But that's now four content/technical-only sessions since the rank data last moved, and it hasn't: zero of 22 tracked keywords have shown a measurable position in a full month of daily checks, the backlink profile hasn't grown past its original single referring domain since tracking began, and Month 2 has now closed with both its KPIs unmet. This isn't a new finding — the last two pulses named the same two structural blockers (off-page link-building at 0/6, and the catalog.ts connector decisions stalled 14+ sessions) as the actual constraints, and neither moved this week because neither is human-independent. Heading into the Month 3 window with the plan's own quarter-review still owed, the honest read is that on-page work alone has now had a full month to show up in rank data and hasn't: the next lever that would actually change this pulse's headline is 20 minutes of human time on directory listings, or a go/no-go call on the stalled connectors — not another blog post or schema fix.
